messages:
emma: Finally finished the office mini-renovation — fished the ethernet through the wall and hid the nest of doom cables behind a planter. pic attached :plant: 

jake: Oooo nice. pics or it didn't happen :eyes:

emma: https://files.redwood/pics/1812349999-ethernet.jpg ... ran a 5m Cat6, used fish tape + coat-hanger trick. Had to drill a 22mm hole and add a grommet.

sachin: Love the cable routing. Did you use shielded cable? interference?

emma: Nope just standard Cat6 UTP. Kept it away from the mains and ran behind the baseboard. No issues.

lana: pro-tip: add foam grommet + a dab of silicone to keep it tidy and cut noise. Also reserve a DHCP IP so your laptop always gets the same address for split-tunnel rules.

emma: added DHCP reservation:
```
host emma-wfh {
  hardware ethernet aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff;
  fixed-address 192.168.1.42;
}
```

jake: Nice! Did you replace the old Wi-Fi extenders? mesh really helped me when the house was a death-trap.

emma: Kept the mesh for phones but switched desktop to wired. Latency dropped from ~20ms jitter to steady 1-2ms for local infra. :thumbsup:

sachin: jealous. Also - did you have to call the ISP? my last attempt ended with the ONT blinking orange for 3 days.

emma: Had a mini-outage during the punch-through. Rebooted the ONT and replaced the splitter. Quick 15-min drama.

lana: Can we get a sweepstake on how long it'll stay tidy before the cat finds it? :cat:

emma: Cat managed 0 minutes 37 seconds. :joy: There is a small chew mark hidden behind the planter, but all good.

jake: PR for home office: 10/10. Send this to #wfh-showcase? :party_parrot:

emma: Will do tomorrow when sunlight is better for photos. Thanks team! :plant::coffee:
